title: MZ Unable to access updated stand-alone versions despite owning a LEGAL activation key because Degica no longer exists and support does not respond

posts.author: Milennin
posts.body:
I have no idea where else to go so now I'm here. I own a
legally
purchased activation key for RPG Maker MZ (and also RPG Maker MV) from when the software released, sent to me by e-mail by Degica which I still have in my inbox. The problem:
Degica, apparently, no longer exists.
The link to some old login page gives a blank "403 forbidden".
There is no downloads page for RPG Maker MZ on this website.
There is no newer version downloads for RPG Maker MZ on these forums.
My account shows no orders on Komodo Plaza.
My account shows no orders on RPG Maker Official Store.
While I can update to the latest version with the software linked to Steam which I use on my main PC, I'm also using a laptop for my project that I use mainly offline, so I do not want to be bound by Steam's login practices. I have a right to the latest stand-alone version with a
legally
purchased key from the official store that previously existed. From what I gather, Komodo Plaza is the replacement store for Degica. I've already contacted them via e-mail, a full week ago. They responded to me asking what e-mail I use to login on their website, I answered them and since then they've gone quiet. Where are customers expected to even go to get access to a download for their
legally
purchased software?

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
This has been asked frequently before. You can use the product key to activate the free trial of MZ (available from the "Downloads" link on the top of the page).
That installer is already updated to version 1.10, which is the latest.

posts.author: Solar_Flare
posts.body: If you already had it installed and just updated, I think it's reasonable to expect that you wouldn't need to put in the key again. The registration status is probably stored in the registry (Windows) or preferences folder (Mac), meaning it would carry across versions.
